reviews.body: My first pair of tennis shoes lasted me 9 years before I retired them. So this is my second pair and needless to say I love them. They are comfortable and help a lot with support. It’d also a plus they look cute with a majority of my wardrobe! Like I said before they are built great and sturdy! I can’t wait to break in my new ones!
These are so exquisitely comfortable. I absolutely LOVE them! Great support and durability, the size and fit are spot on, they're not heavy, and the style is amazing.

I bought these new Adidas shoes specifically for our 25th anniversary trip to Italy, knowing we’d be doing a lot of walking, and they didn’t disappoint. We averaged about 12 miles a day, and while my feet were definitely tired by the end of the day, they never hurt. No blisters, and they gave solid support.

I have wider feet, occasional big-toe issues, and these fit well right out of the box and held up great for long, back-to-back walking days.

Style-wise, they were also perfect. Social media warns about dressing fashion-forward in Italy, but a simple pair of clean white Adidas fits in everywhere without screaming “tourist.” I took these and a pair of ballet flats to dress up for dinner, and that’s all I needed.

The trip is over, and I’m still wearing these regularly. Adidas is my easy go-to.

I’m obsessed with my Gazelle Bolds — they hit that perfect mix of retro and modern. The platform sole gives just enough lift to feel a little elevated without being clunky or uncomfortable. I bought these in the white and silver/green (gorgeous color by the way). I first decided to buy the white to take on my three week trip to Croatia, Paris, Amsterdam. I wasn't sure how the white would hold up without getting really dirty. But non-the-less, I decided they felt so VERY comfortable, it was worth taking them.

First, they were absolutely fantastic to walk in ALL day (7-12 miles of walking per day, as you do on European vacations). I did NOT have to break them in, in any way whatsoever. They were comfortable from the start (and let me add I have a small bunion, from my years of high heels, that apparently loved them too). Oh, and occasionally I'd add a comfort pad if I knew it'd be a long day on my feet; but quite honestly, they're cushy soft anyway and found it was not necessary. My feet were never sore at any time or even by the end of a long walking day; amazing!

Second. They did get a little dirty, and even more so at home from constant wear (love them so much). I have thrown them in a snug garment bag multiple different times, tossed them in the washing machine on a cold water wash and they wash up beautifully without any damage or breakdown to the shoes - but air dry them.

Third. They are so fashionable. They not only feel great but they look fantastic with everything you wear. I've had so many unexpected compliments on them. As I mentioned before, I also bought the silver/green pair. They're gorgeous. What a great color!

So overall, I am SUPER happy with the style, fit, durability and comfort of these shoes. I'd give them 100 stars if I could.
